cases.name: t-rhabdo-beyond-rsi
cases.input:
Study drug: TX-441 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): myalgia, headache
Narrative: A 47-year-old man was admitted for 5 days with rhabdomyolysis (CK 40x ULN). He recovered.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

cases.name: t-mild-nausea
cases.input:
Study drug: TX-441 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): nausea, headache
Narrative: A 31-year-old woman had mild nausea for one day after dosing. No treatment was needed.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

cases.name: t-sponsor-upgrades-optic-neuritis
cases.input:
Study drug: TX-552 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): headache
Narrative: A 39-year-old woman was admitted for 4 days with optic neuritis on day 60 of dosing.
Investigator causality: not related
Sponsor causality: related (reasonable possibility; two similar reports in the programme)

cases.name: t-fatal-listed-ild
cases.input:
Study drug: TX-552 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): interstitial lung disease, cough
Narrative: A 69-year-old man developed interstitial lung disease on day 45 of dosing and died on day 70.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

cases.name: t-ed-urticaria
cases.input:
Study drug: TX-663 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): urticaria, pruritus
Narrative: A 26-year-old man attended the emergency department with urticaria, received an oral antihistamine and was discharged after 2 hours without admission.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

cases.name: t-ed-bronchospasm
cases.input:
Study drug: TX-663 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): rash
Narrative: A 33-year-old woman had allergic bronchospasm and was treated intensively in the emergency department with nebulised bronchodilators and IV steroids. She was discharged the same night without admission.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

cases.name: t-scheduled-hernia
cases.input:
Study drug: TX-774 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): nausea
Narrative: A 55-year-old man was admitted for an inguinal hernia repair scheduled before enrolment. The hernia had not changed during the study.
Investigator causality: not related
Sponsor causality: not related

cases.name: t-anaphylactic-shock
cases.input:
Study drug: TX-774 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): rash
Narrative: A 41-year-old woman had anaphylactic shock (BP 70/40) minutes after infusion, needed adrenaline and was admitted to intensive care for 2 days.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

cases.name: t-hyponatraemia-potential-lt
cases.input:
Study drug: TX-885 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): headache
Narrative: A 64-year-old woman was admitted for 3 days with hyponatraemia (sodium 124 mmol/L). She was otherwise well; the investigator described it as 'potentially life-threatening if not corrected'.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

cases.name: t-unrelated-appendicitis
cases.input:
Study drug: TX-885 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): headache
Narrative: A 22-year-old man was admitted for 2 days with acute appendicitis and had an appendectomy.
Investigator causality: not related
Sponsor causality: not related
